current_land_use: Operating data centre in a west-Aberdeen industrial area
land_notes: Data Center Map lists the facility on Whitemyres Avenue, Aberdeen AB16 6HQ; PeeringDB instead records the address as Lang Stracht, Aberdeen AB15 6DF. Both are preserved: the two postcode centroids are only about 120 m apart and Whitemyres Avenue runs off Lang Stracht within the same DC Thomson / Aberdeen Journals complex, so they are almost certainly two descriptions of the same site rather than two sites. AB16 6HQ is preferred here because it is the more specific street-level listing. Coordinates derive from the Royal Mail postcode unit centroid returned by the postcodes.io API for the postcode recorded above. No building number is published, so the point is a site centroid rather than a door-level fix. Earlier snapshots deliberately coarsened this site; that suppression was lifted on 2026-07-30 because all of it is already public.
